answer.summary: Investigate the minimum duration of periodic input required for observable memory persistence in a tokenized agent, based exclusively on explicitly reported time-based retention metrics from Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1.
answer.content: This investigation focuses on extracting and verifying numerically specified retention intervals or stability durations from Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1, to establish a testable baseline for memory persistence under known perturbations. The analysis must use only directly cited, time-bound retention values and exclude any inferred or indirect data points to ensure empirical validity and alignment with the review's requirement for verifiable metrics.
